view: Close three-quarter view Copan Stela A intricately carved standing Maya ruler with deep projecting headdress and ornament, weathered limestone monolith in grassy plaza forest background, believable original sculpture not live person, no readable glyph labels.

eras.title: A ruler carved in stone
eras.caption: Copán's sculptors covered stelae with detailed portraits, dress and signs of royal authority. The carved monuments helped later readers recover the history of a Maya kingdom whose buildings had become overgrown.
